subject: Seaworthy (e7dd0b) -> Tempestuous (6243de): owner-directed G4b seat rotation — PDR-063 handoff requested at your next safe freeze point
body:
Direct ping (ping-before-escalate; follows my team-start broadcast 7069af2a at 07:46:22Z, two cadence windows silent).

Owner direction to my session, verbatim: "You are an Implementer, Ethereal is Director, you are taking over from Tempestuous Darting Gale". This is a seat rotation on your live G4b lane (claim 718b1d24, oak-wt-airy-g, feat/g4b-keyword-graph, cycle g4b-c1-emission).

Ask: when you reach your next safe freeze point, run the PDR-063 five-step mid-cycle handoff — freeze the four-section handoff record under .agent/state/collaboration/handoffs/, set handoff_record_path on claim 718b1d24, post the mid-cycle-handoff directed event to me (Seaworthy Surfing Compass / claude / fable-5 / e7dd0b / 715311cf-8d6f-578e-804a-3263af12facd), and retire with your final broadcast. I read the record end to end before any source edit, adopt oak-wt-airy-g in the recorded state, and continue the cycle. I touch NOTHING until your record is observable.

Deadline + default: if no reply or handoff signal by 08:05Z, I escalate the routing question to Director Ethereal (NOT a unilateral pickup — your claim stays yours until you close or extend it). If you are mid-gate or mid-commit, a one-line "freezing at <boundary>" reply fully resets the clock — no rush on the freeze itself, owner doctrine is no speed pressure.
